name: playful-red-fashion-editorial
image_vibe: Playful premium monochrome-red fashion scene contrasting photorealism with animated bird companions
image_purpose: Create a distinctive fashion editorial key visual for campaign or concept development.

prompt.project_info: A high-resolution hybrid fashion studio portrait of an original adult woman with two oversized round fluffy red bird characters.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman in a textured red knit sweater, black fitted pants, and red sneakers, standing casually with one arm resting on one of two oversized round fluffy 3D cartoon red birds. The birds have bold eyebrows and bright yellow beaks and are rendered in a polished high-quality 3D animation style.
prompt.composition_elements: Place the woman and two bird companions in a clean monochrome red studio, with the woman as the realistic focal point and the birds providing rounded graphic counterforms. Keep the arm-on-bird interaction clear and leave balanced negative space around the group.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio lighting with gentle shadows, clean red-on-red tonal control, premium playful editorial mood, and clear separation between the photorealistic woman and stylized 3D characters.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution fashion photography, 50mm lens, f/5.6, realistic skin and knit texture, clean 3D fur and material rendering for the birds, controlled red color grade, subtle natural vignette, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-resolution hybrid fashion studio portrait of an original adult woman wearing a textured red knit sweater, black fitted pants, and red sneakers. Have her stand casually with one arm resting on one of two oversized round fluffy red bird characters with bold eyebrows and bright yellow beaks. Render the birds in a polished high-quality 3D animation style while keeping the woman photorealistic. Set the entire scene against a clean monochrome red studio background with soft diffused lighting and gentle shadows. Use a 50mm lens at f/5.6, realistic skin and knit texture, clean 3D fur and material rendering, controlled red color grading, premium playful editorial composition, subtle natural vignette, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed bird characters, inconsistent rendering styles, muddy red tones, plastic skin, over-smooth, over-saturated, watermark, text

assets.name: source playful red bird fashion scene
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for the red monochrome studio, arm-on-bird pose, bird shapes, and hybrid photorealistic/3D treatment; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult fashion subject, red sweater/black pants/red sneakers, two oversized red bird companions, monochrome red studio, and playful premium editorial contrast. Identity and non-essential bird details may vary.
